info.name: EC2 Image Builder CancelImageCreation CreateImageRecipe API
info.description:
EC2 Image Builder is a fully managed Amazon Web Services service that makes it easier to automate the creation, management, and deployment of customized, secure, and up-to-date "golden" server images that are pre-installed and pre-configured with software and settings to meet specific IT standards.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mike Ralphson
 Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com

item.name: Amazon EC2 Image Builder Create Image Recipe

request.description: Creates a new image recipe. Image recipes define how images are configured, tested, and assessed.
